Definition: from G1223 and G4198; to travel through:--go through, journey in, pass by.
BiblicalUsage: To pass through is to travel across a place on the way to somewhere else. Jesus passes through the cornfields on the Sabbath, He passes through towns and villages teaching on His way to Jerusalem, and Paul passes through the churches confirming them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that passing through is the picture of the Christian life. We are travellers, not settlers, and every town and field we cross is a place to teach, to heal, and to leave stronger than we found it.
